sources.title: Синтетический тестовый файл для stage-8 recheck
sources.notes: Явно помечен как искусственный workflow fixture; никаких наблюдений пилота не содержит.

claims.text: The synthetic funnel table lists Q1 conversion of 18% and Q4 conversion of 11%, a 7 percentage-point difference in the invented scenario.
claims.exact_location: Rows Q1 and Q4; conversion_rate_pct column.
claims.notes: High confidence that these values appear in the fictional fixture, not that they describe a real product.

claims.text: The synthetic table lists Q4 as 1,320 paid conversions from 12,000 eligible trials.
claims.exact_location: Row Q4; paid_conversions and eligible_trials columns.
claims.notes: Fictional data.

claims.text: The feedback snippets and onboarding descriptions are explicitly fictional and not user research or observed interface evidence.
claims.exact_location: Provenance headings at the beginning of both documents.
claims.notes: Describes fixture provenance only.

claims.text: The Eurostat cloud-use dataset is labeled 2014-2020 and does not provide a directly comparable trial-to-paid benchmark for this case.
claims.exact_location: Eurostat dataset metadata label; market_benchmark.md sections 'Sources' and 'What this can and cannot tell us'.
claims.notes: Non-comparability is a methodological limitation, not a claim about market demand.

claims.text: The calculator returns LTV 1,077.916667 RUB, CAC 1,000 RUB, and payback 7.730963 months for the synthetic monthly inputs.
claims.exact_location: economics_input.json values; economics_result.json ltv, cac, and payback_months fields.
claims.notes: Deterministic output for illustrative assumptions; not validated business economics.

claims.text: The invented quarter-to-quarter conversion difference could reflect experience friction, changes in traffic or offer mix, measurement changes, or a combination; the fixture cannot identify its cause.
claims.exact_location: Q1-Q4 cohort rows; no instrumentation or traffic-mix metadata is supplied.
claims.notes: Requires validated production instrumentation to test.

claims.text: Permission clarity or understanding of family-sharing value may be a barrier worth testing with real eligible users.
claims.exact_location: Fictional snippets 1 and 3; fictional Screen 2.
claims.notes: The authored prompts are not evidence of real user prevalence.

claims.text: Uncertainty about trial length, renewal, price, or cancellation may be a barrier that merits research.
claims.exact_location: Fictional snippets 2 and 4; fictional Screen 3.
claims.notes: No real product terms were provided.

claims.text: The illustrative LTV/CAC result is not decision-grade until retention, gross margin, acquisition attribution, customer count, servicing cost, and cannibalization are verified.
claims.exact_location: Synthetic assumption inputs; calculator assumptions and exclusions.
claims.notes: High confidence in the limitation, not in the true economics.

claims.text: Validating trial measurement and product truth before any intervention is the safest immediate posture in the fictional scenario.
claims.exact_location: Cohort table definition gaps; fictional screen omissions.
claims.notes: Decision logic for a fictional demo, not operational advice for a real service.

claims.text: The fixture does not establish a case for closing a real direction because it contains no validated lifetime value, cannibalization, customer obligations, or actual demand evidence.
claims.exact_location: All supplied demo data and the benchmark comparability limitations.
claims.notes: Insufficient evidence is not evidence that the actual product should be retained.

claims.text: The proposed experiment is not decision-grade until assignment, eligibility, data quality, safety guardrails, and analysis/stopping rules are specified and approved.
claims.exact_location: Proposed A/B test in this strategy; source fixtures lack event, eligibility, and real product details.
claims.notes: Methodological requirement for the proposed test; it is not evidence about an actual product.

claims.text: An illustrative change from 11.0% to 13.5% is a hypothetical minimum-detectable-effect planning input, not a forecast or expected real-world result.
claims.exact_location: Row Q4 baseline conversion_rate_pct; target is an explicitly chosen scenario assumption.
claims.notes: Planning threshold only, not a forecast.

claims.text: Scaling should be rejected if verified incremental contribution after service costs and cannibalization is negative or conversion lift does not persist to a retention checkpoint.
claims.exact_location: Economic inputs and documented excluded costs.
claims.notes: Conditional decision rule; actual thresholds require owner approval.

claims.text: A gated account-randomized test could isolate one family-sharing permission clarification while holding price, trial terms, storage-value copy, eligibility, and traffic mix fixed, followed by retention and guardrail review.
claims.exact_location: Fictional Screen 2 and Q4 baseline; proposed test design.
claims.notes: Requires pre-registration, power analysis, and approval; sample count is provisional.

claims.text: The contest brief describes a fictional mobile operator and states that all numerical values are educational.
claims.exact_location: p. 1, heading 'Связь для близких и собственных устройств' and text 'вымышленного мобильного оператора'; p. 3, 'Все числа учебные'.
claims.notes: High confidence about the source's framing, not about any real operator.

claims.text: The brief describes family groups sharing a data package and people managing multiple numbers of their own.
claims.exact_location: p. 1, paragraphs 'Семейная группа' and 'Собственные номера и устройства'.
claims.notes: These are the two scenario types in the educational brief.

claims.text: The educational market includes 300,000 households and 180,000 owners of multiple numbers, with accessible bases of 100,000 households and 40,000 owners; overlap is excluded from the market count.
claims.exact_location: p. 3, 'Рынок и исходные показатели', opening paragraph.
claims.notes: Scenario inputs, not measured market data.

claims.text: The no-change forecast is 8,000 connected family groups at year-end and the educational target is 12,000.
claims.exact_location: p. 3, baseline/plan-year table, row 'Подключённые семейные группы на конец года'; cross-check p. 6, 'Как свести числа'.
claims.notes: Targets and forecasts as stated in the brief, not actual results.

claims.text: The no-change forecast is 5,000 active family groups in the last month of the year and the educational target is 8,000.
claims.exact_location: p. 3, baseline/plan-year table, row 'Активные семейные группы за последний месяц года'.
claims.notes: The brief defines an active group in the paragraph immediately below the table.

claims.text: The 14-day activation estimate for groups created in the final quarter is 42%, the no-change forecast is 45%, and the educational target is 60%.
claims.exact_location: p. 3, baseline/plan-year table, row 'Группы, активированные за 14 дней'; definition below the table.
claims.notes: The source specifies that created groups with unanswered invitations remain in the denominator.

claims.text: The no-change forecast is 1,000 connected owners of multiple numbers at year-end and the educational target is 2,000.
claims.exact_location: p. 3, baseline/plan-year table, row 'Подключённые владельцы нескольких номеров на конец года'.
claims.notes: Owners, not SIM cards, are the denominator for this scenario.

claims.text: The plan-year gross-profit estimate is 275 million RUB, the no-change forecast is 279 million RUB, and the educational minimum target is 285 million RUB.
claims.exact_location: p. 3, baseline/plan-year table, row 'Валовая прибыль за год, млн руб.'; p. 9, first paragraph.
claims.notes: All values are educational scenario numbers.

claims.text: The brief says a family participant controls access to their number information and may revoke permission; a payer confirms charges from their account, and the organizer, number owner, and payer may differ.
claims.exact_location: p. 1, paragraph beginning 'Организатор приглашает людей в группу'.
claims.notes: Permission to view remaining data does not by itself grant access to charges; see p. 5, family journey.

claims.text: The brief states that an organizer can already allocate available shared data when plan terms permit, while battery status requires reliable device-provided data.
claims.exact_location: p. 1, paragraphs 'Семейная группа' and 'Собственные номера и устройства'.
claims.notes: Describes the fictional operator's baseline capability, not a real service.

claims.text: The brief lists alternatives including a shared family plan, bank auto-payment, asking a relative directly in chat, the account cabinet, and a device app.
claims.exact_location: p. 5, section 'Объясните, почему клиент выберет этот способ'.
claims.notes: Alternatives are presented by the brief; their effectiveness is not measured.

claims.text: The brief recommends randomizing eligible customers where possible, assigning a whole family or owner cluster, retaining non-openers in the analysis, and sizing the sample from event frequency and meaningful effect.
claims.exact_location: p. 8, 'Как провести пробный запуск', paragraphs 'С чем сравнивать', 'Что считать', and 'Хватит ли времени'.
claims.notes: The example of 600 groups is illustrative and not a sample-size calculation for this case.

claims.text: The brief provides a 500 RUB gross-profit contribution per additional paid number-month and states that the 6 million RUB gap requires 12,000 such months before new costs.
claims.exact_location: p. 9, 'Как рассчитать прибыль и окупаемость', paragraphs 'Начните с 279 млн руб.' and 'Проверьте границу решения'.
claims.notes: Paid-month gains must be incremental against the unchanged-service baseline.

claims.text: The reproducible threshold mode of calc_economics.py returns a 6,000,000 RUB gross-profit gap and 12,000 minimum incremental paid months before new direct costs.
claims.exact_location: economics_result.json, fields gross_profit_gap and minimum_incremental_paid_months_before_new_direct_costs.
claims.notes: Arithmetic threshold only; not a forecast, LTV, CAC, or payback estimate.

claims.text: The brief lists 0.5 FTE each for a designer and analyst as not yet allocated, three developer person-months provisionally for Q2, and one testing person-month not yet confirmed.
claims.exact_location: p. 11, table 'Ресурсы', rows 'Дизайнер и аналитик', 'Разработчики', and 'Специалист по проверке услуги'.
claims.notes: Availability and costs are not confirmed.

claims.text: The user set the decision owner role as product_lead, a four-quarter planning horizon, and an orientation at the end of year three.
claims.exact_location: User instruction dated 2026-11-20 19:06 +0300; confirmed in projects/megafon-demo/brief.md under 'Владелец и сроки'.
claims.notes: The role is known; no individual is named.

claims.text: For eligible family groups with consent and available shared data, an alert at a validated low-balance event may reduce restrictions caused by data exhaustion within seven days.
claims.exact_location: Derived from p. 1, 'Семейная группа', and p. 7, proposed seven-day customer-benefit metric.
claims.notes: Falsified if a sufficiently precise controlled estimate rules out the pre-agreed minimum useful reduction, or if timely actionable balance is unavailable.

claims.text: Family groups may be the better first validation segment than owners of multiple numbers because the brief describes an existing shared-data action and a larger accessible base, but relative incidence and preventability are unknown.
claims.exact_location: p. 1, 'Семейная группа'; p. 3, accessible market counts; p. 4, 'Обоснуйте первый приоритет'.
claims.notes: Falsified if the own-number segment has materially greater preventable harm per cost or family incidents are rare/non-actionable.

claims.text: A timely alert that links to an existing permitted action may be a lower-cost first test than building a new family dashboard or automating transfer.
claims.exact_location: p. 5, 'Определите состав первого запуска' and alternatives; p. 7, compare a cabinet with a simpler alert.
claims.notes: Falsified if the existing path is unavailable, confusing, unsafe, or yields no useful customer effect.

claims.text: Cluster randomization at the family-group level can estimate the causal effect of the alert on eligible groups if event definitions, consent, outcome access, and sample size are valid.
claims.exact_location: p. 8, 'Кого включать', 'С чем сравнивать', and 'Что считать'.
claims.notes: Falsified as decision-ready if cross-group contamination, unequal outcome measurement, or insufficient event flow prevents interpretable comparison.

claims.text: The alert could support the gross-profit target only if it creates measurable incremental paid months or other verified contribution that exceeds incremental operating and development costs.
claims.exact_location: p. 9, retention, support savings, and cost paragraphs; economics_result.json threshold and limitations.
claims.notes: Falsified if validated incremental contribution after costs and cannibalization is negative or below the approved hurdle.

claims.text: A safe pilot can launch by the end of Q1 only if the existing notification/data/consent path and staffing are ready; otherwise a Q1 decision should defer or narrow launch.
claims.exact_location: p. 11, dependency and staffing sections; user instruction dated 2026-11-20 19:06 +0300 for the Q1 control point.
claims.notes: Falsified if the necessary safe path is not available in time; never replace the missing readiness with manual access to customer data.

claims.text: A goal-aligned plan-year scenario would require reaching the brief's targets; those values are a conditional boundary, not a point forecast from available evidence.
claims.exact_location: p. 3 target column and p. 6 discussion of the gap versus unchanged service.
claims.notes: No channel conversion, churn, or intervention effect is provided to estimate probability of reaching the targets.

claims.text: For the educational case, every 500 RUB of new direct costs increases the required additional paid-month threshold by one, subject to ceiling rounding.
claims.exact_location: economics_result.json threshold_formula; p. 9, 500 RUB per paid-month assumption.
claims.notes: Conditional arithmetic; not evidence that any such months or costs will occur.

claims.text: A provisional end-of-year-three floor could retain at least 12,000 connected and 8,000 active family groups, subject to product_lead approval and revision after year-one cohort and economics data.
claims.exact_location: p. 3 year-one targets and p. 10, 'Для конца третьего года задайте измеримый ориентир'; user horizon instruction dated 2026-11-20.
claims.notes: An explicitly proposed planning floor, not an independently validated growth forecast.

claims.text: The Q1 interim file is explicitly labeled a synthetic workflow test fixture and states that it contains no customer observations or pilot results.
claims.exact_location: data/new/megafon_q1_pilot_interim.md, heading 'SYNTHETIC WORKFLOW TEST FIXTURE — NOT PILOT DATA' and first paragraph.
claims.notes: This proves only the declared purpose/content of the fixture, not any real-world interim result.
